question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**are**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, blank 2 will describe the subject i.e. "some of the things."**
 
• **The verb "are" is the only option that makes grammatical sense in the blank space**.
 
 
• "Are" is the third person present form of "to exist" or "
